blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/ .
blocks.zh: 细胞生存能力评估是细胞培养系统中的一项核心要求,在生药制造和药物开发中具有关键应用. 在常规上,它通过在样品中添加膜-不透膜染料来测量(一种称为染色的过程),这使得受损的细胞膜能够与完好无损的细胞膜相区别. 然而,污渍有几种局限性:(a)化学剂可以扰动被测量细胞的正常细胞过程;(b)将生命力分配给细胞膜完整性仅被部分损害的单个细胞往往模糊不清. (c) 在使用荧光污点时,光裂会损害测量的准确性;(d) 污点不能在原地或实时进行。 在这里,我们显示:(1) 在亮地成像下捕获的被污染的细胞包含足够的信息,可以区分活细胞和死细胞;(2) 在无污地成像下捕获的被污染的细胞呈现出与被污染的对应物相类似的图像特征,使受过被污染细胞培训的模型能够被概括为被污染细胞. 然后我们报告ViabiLens的开发与验证,这是用于无标签细胞生存能力分析的AI辅助软件. ViabiLens将单个细胞局部化的细胞检测模型与活性/死性预测的进化神经网络分级器(CNN)结合,并配以交互式的基于UMAP的取景器,用于可视化和探索整个样本中的单个细胞. 对覆盖广泛生存条件的中国仓鼠卵巢(CHO)细胞进行评估后,ViabiLens对照荧光参考测量结果,在未染色样本上实现2.68%的平均绝对误差. 我们还发布了一个无标签细胞生存能力分析的基准数据集,以便利今后的研究,该数据集可查阅https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cell culture technology is central to the biopharmaceutical industry, where living cells are grown in bioreactors to produce therapeutic proteins such as monoclonal antibodies [ 18 ] . CHO cells are the mammalian cell line most widely used for this purpose [ 50 , 19 ] . Biologics produced this way now dominate the pharmaceutical industry, accounting for 8 of the 10 top-selling drugs in 2023 [ 46 ] and reaching a record 40% share of FDA approvals in 2022, a steady rise over the past 25 years [ 27 ] . Key to consistent and predictable operation of cell culture systems is the ability to accurately know the total number of cells (cell count) and the percentage of live or dead cells (cell viability). Beyond bio-production, cells themselves are increasingly being used as therapeutics, including CAR-T cells, stem cells, and tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapies [ 36 ] . As dying cells can reduce therapeutic efficacy and pose immunological risks to patients, accurate measurement of cellular health is particularly important [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 细胞培养技术是生物制药工业的核心,活细胞生长在生物反应器中,以产生单克隆抗体等治疗性蛋白[18]. CHO细胞是用于此目的最广泛的哺乳动物细胞线[50,19]. 生物制品现在以这种方式主导了制药业,在2023年[46]的10个最畅销药品中占据了8个,并在2022年达到创纪录的40%的FDA批准份额,在过去25年中稳步上升[27]. 细胞培养系统持续和可预见运行的关键是能够准确了解细胞总数(细胞计数)和活细胞或死细胞的百分比(细胞生存能力). 除了生物生产之外,细胞本身也越来越多地被作为治疗方法,包括CAR-T细胞,干细胞和肿瘤渗入淋巴细胞疗法[36]. 由于垂死的细胞会降低疗效并给患者带来免疫风险,因此准确测量细胞健康尤为重要 [2].

blocks.en: Conventional approaches for measuring cell viability typically rely on membrane-impermeable dyes (e.g., Trypan Blue or the combination of acridine orange (AO) and propidium iodide (PI)), where loss of membrane integrity is used as an indicator of cell death [ 29 , 35 ] . In AO/PI assays, live and dead cells emit fluorescence at different wavelengths based on membrane permeability, enabling their discrimination via fluorescence imaging (Fig. 1 ). However, this approach is subject to several limitations. First, the requirement to add chemical agents introduces inherent disruption to the sample: cells exposed to staining agents may behave differently from unstained cells, and in some cases the staining process itself can kill the cells being measured [ 21 ] . Dye exposure can also cause dead cells to rupture and break apart into debris, causing them to be under-counted and biasing measured viability upward [ 5 , 6 ] . Second, the boundary between live and dead populations is not always clear-cut, as cells sometimes appear in both fluorescent channels simultaneously. In addition, PI positivity does not always mean death. For example, cells stressed by heat can take up PI immediately, but their membranes often reseal shortly afterwards [ 11 ] . Third, photobleaching (the progressive loss of fluorescent signal that occurs when a fluorophore is exposed to excitation light [ 24 ] ) can reduce measurement reliability over time. Finally, because a physical sample must be pulled manually from the bioreactor and chemically prepared prior to imaging, these measurements cannot be performed in situ or in real time. This manual process is also time-consuming, increases the risk of contaminating the batch, and prevents continuous monitoring of cell health [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 测量细胞可行性的常规方法通常依赖于膜-隐性染料(如Trypan Blue或丙烯酸橙(AO)和碘化ium(PI)的结合),其中膜完整性的丧失被作为细胞死亡的指标[29,35]. 在AO/PI的化验中,活细胞和死细胞根据膜通透性以不同的波长发出荧光,使得它们能够通过荧光成像进行区分(图1)。 然而,这种办法受到若干限制。 首先,要求添加化学剂会给样品带来内在的干扰:接触污物剂的细胞的行为可能不同于未被污染的细胞,在某些情况下,污物过程本身可以杀死被测量的细胞 [21]. Dye接触还会导致死细胞破裂并分解为碎片,导致它们被低估,并有偏差地向上衡量可行性[5,6]。 第二,活体和死体之间的界限并不总是清晰的,因为细胞有时同时出现在两个荧光道上. 此外,PI假设并不总是意味着死亡. 例如,受热所压力的细胞可以立即取出PI,但是它们的膜往往会很快地在[11]后再生. 第三,光裂(一氟磷被激发光照射出后会逐渐失去荧光信号[24])可以随着时间的推移而降低测量可靠性. 最后,由于在成像之前必须手动从生物反应器中提取物理样品并进行化学准备,因此这些测量不能在原地或实时进行. 这一人工过程也耗费了时间,增加了污染批量的风险,并阻止了细胞健康的连续监测[7].

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of traditional and proposed methods for cell viability assessment. Left: A bioreactor used for cell culture. Middle: Traditionally, cells are stained and fluorescently imaged to distinguish live from dead cells. Right: The proposed deep-learning-based method detects and classifies individual cells as live or dead directly from brightfield images, without staining or fluorescence imaging. In either case, sample-level viability is computed as the ratio of live cells to the total cell count.
blocks.zh: 图1:细胞可行性评估的传统方法和拟议方法的比较。 左边 : 用于细胞培养的活化反应器. 中间 : 传统上,细胞被染上并被荧光映射,以区别活细胞和死细胞. 对: 所拟议的以深度学习为基础的方法检测并直接从亮地图像中将单个细胞归类为活体或死体,而无需染色或荧光成像. 在这两种情况下,样本层面的可行性都作为活细胞与细胞总数的比率来计算。

blocks.en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have provided an alternative approach to bypass the staining process altogether. A common example is virtual staining, in which neural networks with U-Net-like architectures [ 40 ] are trained to predict fluorescence images directly from brightfield or phase contrast inputs [ 15 , 9 , 26 , 39 ] . These methods, however, require accurately co-registered image pairs for training, which are not always available in practice or are laborious to acquire at the volumes needed for proper training. Furthermore, virtual staining shares some of the same limitations as physical staining: some cells appear in both predicted fluorescent channels, leading to ambiguous viability classification. Since viability is ultimately defined as the ratio of live to total cells, cell counting must still be performed on the predicted fluorescence images, meaning an additional postprocessing step is required. An alternative strategy formulates viability assessment as a cell detection and classification problem, where individual cells are first localized and subsequently classified. This paradigm has been applied to different imaging modalities, including second harmonic generation and autofluorescence microscopy [ 8 ] , optical coherence microscopy [ 31 ] , brightfield imaging [ 12 , 22 ] , phase imaging [ 41 ] , 2D light scattering [ 23 ] , differential interference contrast [ 4 ] , and digital holographic imaging [ 47 ] . Despite recent progress, existing studies are mostly evaluated on limited datasets covering a narrow range of viability conditions [ 8 , 31 , 12 , 22 , 23 , 47 ] , are often trained and validated on stained samples [ 12 , 22 ] , and frequently rely on complicated optical setups.
blocks.zh: 人工智能最近的进展为完全绕过污渍过程提供了另一种方法。 一个常见的例子是虚拟污点,其中具有U-Net类架构的神经网络[40]被训练出直接从亮地或相向对比输入预测荧光图像[15,9,26,39]. 然而,这些方法需要准确的、共同注册的图像对培训,在实践中并不总是如此,或者在适当培训所需的数量上很难获得。 此外,虚拟污渍与物理污渍有一些相同的限制:一些细胞出现在两个预测的荧光通道中,导致可行性分类模棱两可. 由于生命力最终被定义为活细胞与总细胞之比,所以细胞计数仍然必须在所预测的荧光图像上进行,这意味着需要额外的后处理步骤. 另一种战略将可行性评估制定为一个细胞检测和分类问题,其中单个细胞首先被本地化,然后被分类。 这个范式被应用于不同的成像模式,包括第二发口琴和自发荧光显微镜[8],光学一致性显微镜[31],亮地成像[12,22],相相相成像[41],相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 尽管最近取得了进展,但现有研究大多是在有限的数据集上评价的,这些数据集涵盖范围很窄的可行性条件[8、31、12、22、23、47],经常在有污迹的样本上接受训练和验证[12、22],并经常依赖复杂的光学装置。

blocks.en: In addition, the assumption that unstained images are sufficiently similar to stained ones has rarely been examined. This is particularly important as ground-truth viability labels can only be obtained from stained samples, so models must be trained on stained images and then applied to unstained ones to enable label-free assessment. If staining alters cell morphology, the model’s ability to generalize from stained to unstained images will be limited.
blocks.zh: 此外,关于未被污染的图像与被污染的图像足够相似的假设也很少被审查. 这一点特别重要,因为地面-真实可行性标签只能取自有污点的样品,因此模型必须接受有污点图像的培训,然后应用于有污点的模型,以便能够进行无污点的评估。 如果污渍改变细胞形态,模型从污渍到未被污渍的图像的通俗化能力将受到限制。

blocks.en: In this work, we present ViabiLens, a deep-learning-based pipeline for predicting the viability of label-free cells directly from brightfield images. We first examine whether brightfield images of stained cells contain sufficient information to distinguish live cells from dead ones. Building on this, we develop two supervised models: a cell detection model for localizing individual cells and a CNN classifier for assigning viability labels to each detected cell, both trained on stained samples. A key underlying assumption is that staining does not fundamentally alter the brightfield appearance of cells, allowing a model trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We first validate this assumption by analyzing the image features of individual stained and unstained cells, showing that the two populations exhibit closely matching distributions. We then test our pipeline on paired stained and unstained samples withheld from training, spanning a wide range of viability conditions. On CHO cells, our pipeline achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68% against fluorescence-based measurement. Repeating the experiments under different imaging modalities, e.g. phase imaging across different focal planes, gives consistent results. These findings demonstrate the generalizability of our approach and show that unstained transmitted light images can be used directly for label-free viability prediction.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了ViabiLens,这是一条基于深度学习的管道,用于直接从亮地图像中预测无标签细胞的可行性. 我们首先检查被污染的细胞的亮地图像是否包含足够的信息来区分活细胞和活细胞. 在此基础上,我们开发出两个有监督的模型:一个细胞检测模型,用于单个细胞本地化,另一个是CNN分类器,用于为每个被检测到的细胞分配生命力标签,两者都受过污渍样本的培训. 一个关键的基本假设是:污迹不会从根本上改变细胞的亮地外观,使得一个被训练出有被污迹细胞的模型能够被概括到无被污迹细胞上. 我们首先通过分析被污和未被污的细胞的图像特征来验证这一假设,表明这两个种群的分布非常吻合。 然后,我们试验我们的输油管,试验成对的、不经过训练的样品,这些样品涉及广泛的生存条件。 在CHO细胞上,我们的输油管在荧光测量上实现了2.68%的平均绝对误差. 在不同的成像模式下重复实验,例如相相成像跨越不同的焦平面,产生一致的结果. 这些发现表明我们的方法是通用的,并表明不染色的传输光图像可以直接用于无标签的可行性预测.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: The overall methodology is shown in Fig. 2 . Our pipeline consists of two stages: an object detection model for localizing individual cells, followed by a CNN classifier to predict their viability. We first describe the image acquisition procedure, including sample preparation, imaging settings, and the train/test split. We then detail the cell detection and classification models, followed by the evaluation metrics used to assess each stage.
blocks.zh: 总体方法如图2所示。 我们的管道由两个阶段组成:一个将单个细胞定位的物体探测模型,然后是CNN分类器来预测它们的可行性。 我们首先描述了图像获取程序,包括样本准备,成像设置,以及列车/测试分拆. 然后我们详细说明细胞检测和分类模型,然后是用来评估每个阶段的评价指标。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of the cell detection and viability analysis pipeline. The brightfield image is divided into 100 overlapping crops (25% overlap in each direction), with red-shaded regions indicating overlap with adjacent crops. Each crop is independently fed into a trained model, and only bounding boxes falling fully within the green frame are retained to discard incomplete cells near boundaries. Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) with an Intersection over Union (IoU) threshold of 0.3 is then applied to remove redundant detections within each crop.
Bounding box coordinates are then shifted to full image space, where a second NMS (at I ​ o ​ U = 0.2 IoU=0.2 ) eliminates duplicate detections arising from cells appearing in red-shaded regions. Each detected cell is resized to 32 × \times 32 pixels and classified as live or dead by the CNN model.
blocks.zh:
图 2:细胞检测和可行性分析管道概述. 亮地图像被分为100个相重叠的作物(每个方向重叠25%),被红色阴影的区域表示与相邻的作物重叠. 每种作物都独立地被装入训练有素的模型中,只有完全属于绿色框架的边框被保留下来去丢弃靠近边界的不完整细胞. 然后,在联盟(IoU)上方采用0.3分界线的非Maximum抑制(NMS)去除每种作物中的多余检测.
然后将相接箱坐标移到完整的图像空间,其中第二个NMS(在I o U = 0.2 IoU = 0.2)消除了由红阴影区域出现的细胞产生的重复检测. 每个被检测到的细胞被调整为32×时32像素并被CNN模型归类为活活或活.

blocks.en: 2.1 Sample Preparation
blocks.zh: 2.1 样本准备

blocks.en: NISTCHO, a clonal CHO-K1 cell line producing cNISTmAb (NIST, SKU 8675), was thawed and cultured in 30 mL of EX-CELL® CD CHO Fusion medium (MilliporeSigma, cat. 14365C) in a 125 mL shake flask at 37 ∘ C, 135 rpm (25 mm throw), 80% relative humidity, and 5% CO 2 . Cells were passaged every 3–4 days by dilution into fresh medium and seeded at 0.3–0.4 × 10 6 \times 10^{6} cells/mL. To obtain samples spanning the range of viabilities typically encountered in bioprocessing, fed-batch cultures were inoculated at 0.8 × 10 6 \times 10^{6} cells/mL in EX-CELL® Advanced CHO Fed-batch Medium (MilliporeSigma, cat. 14365C) or Fusion medium in a 2 L shake flask with an initial working volume of 492 mL. Starting on day 3 and every other day thereafter, EX-CELL Advanced CHO Feed 1 (MilliporeSigma, cat. 24368C) was added at 5% (v/v), and a 400 g/L glucose solution (MilliporeSigma, cat. G7021) was fed daily to restore the glucose concentration to 6 g/L. Cultures were maintained for 14 days, with samples taken at multiple time points for imaging.

blocks.en: 2.2 Image Acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.2 获取图像

blocks.en: Cells were stained at a 1:1 volumetric ratio with ViaStain™ AO-PI staining solution (Revvity cat. CS2-0106-5ML) and incubated for 10 minutes prior to imaging. A total of 75 stained CHO cell images (resolution 2080 × 2784 2080\times 2784 pixels; 1.37 ​ mm × 1.84 ​ mm 1.37~\mathrm{mm}\times 1.84~\mathrm{mm} ) were collected using the Cellaca™ PLX image cytometer over a two-week period. For 15 of these stained images, corresponding pre-staining brightfield images were also acquired immediately prior to dye addition. These 15 stained/unstained image pairs were held out as the test set and were not used at any stage of training. For stained samples, the PLX instrument provides (i) one brightfield image and two corresponding fluorescence images, each acquired using a separate fluorescent channel to detect AO and PI fluorescence respectively (470/532 nm excitation/emission at 15 ms exposure for AO; 531/655 nm at 40 ms for PI), as shown in Fig. 1 , (ii) cell-level bounding boxes, and (iii) live/dead viability labels for each cell; none of these annotations are available for the unstained images. We use the PLX-provided bounding boxes and viability labels for training.

blocks.en: 2.3 Cell Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 单元格检测

blocks.en: To isolate individual cells in transmitted-light images, several approaches have been proposed. Before the deep learning era, classical image-processing methods were the primary tools for cell detection and segmentation, relying on fixed pipelines such as edge detection and morphological processing (e.g. the Watershed approach [ 48 ] ). However, these algorithms often struggle in the presence of overlapping cells. More recently, deep learning-based methods have emerged as a more robust alternative. In particular, instance segmentation and object detection models can directly predict pixel-level masks or bounding boxes for individual cells. By training on small clusters as well, architectures such as Mask R-CNN [ 13 ] , Faster R-CNN [ 38 ] , YOLO [ 37 ] , and DETR [ 3 ] enable more accurate separation of overlapping cells in a broader range of environments.
blocks.zh: 为了在传送光图像中孤立单个细胞,提出了几种方法。 在深度学习时代之前,古典图像处理方法是细胞检测和分化的主要工具,依赖于边缘检测和形态处理等固定管道(如"水分"方法[48]). 然而,这些算法往往在细胞相重叠的情况下挣扎. 最近,以学习为基础的深层方法已成为更强有力的替代办法。 尤其是实例分解和对象检测模型可以直接预测单个细胞的像素级口罩或边框. 通过对小集群的培训,诸如Mask R-CNN[13],更快的R-CNN[38],YOLO[37],以及DETR[3]等架构,能够在更广泛的环境中更准确地分离出重叠的细胞.

blocks.en: Because our PLX dataset provides bounding boxes, we trained an object detector (using the Faster R-CNN architecture) rather than an instance segmentation model. The model used a ResNet-50-FPN [ 14 ] backbone initialized with weights pretrained on the COCO dataset [ 25 ] and was fine-tuned for binary detection (cell vs. background). Training directly on full-resolution ( 2080 × 2784 2080\times 2784 ) images led to poor performance due to the large image area and relatively small cell size. We therefore divided each image into 100 overlapping crops of size 260 × 348 260\times 348 pixels. The training set consisted of 45 stained images, resulting in a total of 4,500 crops. Bounding-box annotations provided by PLX were used as ground-truth labels. Input images were standardized using the dataset mean and standard deviation before training. The model was trained for 25 epochs with a batch size of 4 using stochastic gradient descent with a learning rate of 0.001, momentum of 0.9, and weight decay of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: 因为我们的PLX数据集提供边框,我们训练了一个对象探测器(使用更快速的R-CNN架构),而不是一个实例分解模型. 该型号使用ResNet-50-FPN [14]个主干线被初始化,在COCO数据集上预加了重量分数 [25] 并被微调为二进制检测(cell vs. 直接接受全分辨率(2080×2784 2080\times 2784)图像培训,由于图像面积较大,细胞体积相对较小,导致性能不佳. 因此,我们把每个图像分为100个相重叠的大小为260×348260\times348像素的作物. 培训包括45个有污名的图像,共产生了4 500个作物。 PLX提供的Brounding-box说明被用作地上真实标签. 输入图像在培训前使用数据集平均值和标准偏差进行了标准化。 该模型为25个纪元所训练,分批大小为4个纪元,采用分期梯度下降法,学习速度为0.001分,动力为0.9分,重量衰减为5×10−4 5\times 10^{-4}.

blocks.en: The inference process is shown in Fig. 2 . At inference, each image was divided into 100 overlapping crops matching the training resolution, with 25% overlap in both dimensions to ensure that cells near the boundaries appeared fully within at least one crop. Each crop was independently fed into a trained model, and only bounding boxes falling fully within the central safe zone were retained to discard incomplete cells near the crop boundaries. Since object detectors typically return multiple overlapping bounding boxes per object, NMS [ 30 ] (with I ​ o ​ U = 0.3 IoU=0.3 ) was applied to remove redundant detections within each crop. Bounding box coordinates were then shifted to the full image space.
blocks.zh: 推论过程如图2所示. 推论,每个图像被分为100个与训练分辨率相匹配的相重叠的作物,两个维相重叠25%,以确保边界附近的细胞完全出现在至少一个作物内. 每种作物都独立地被装入训练有素的模型,只有完全位于中央安全区的捆绑箱被保留下来去丢弃作物边界附近的不完全的细胞. 由于物体探测器通常每个物体返回多个相重叠的边框,NMS[30](用Io U=0.3 IoU=0.3)被应用去去除每个作物内的多余探测. 然后将相撞的盒子坐标转移到整个图像空间。

blocks.en: Since a cell may appear in the overlapping regions of adjacent crops, a second NMS (with I ​ o ​ U = 0.2 IoU=0.2 ) was applied to eliminate duplicate detections between crops. To maintain fixed-size inputs for the classification models, each detected cell was resized to 32 × 32 32\times 32 px and fed into the CNN. This size was selected because 95% of cells were 19 × 18 19\times 18 px or smaller, while preserving aspect ratio and minimizing distortion for most cells. Anti-aliasing was applied during resizing to avoid downsampling artifacts for larger cells.
blocks.zh: 由于一个细胞可能出现在相邻作物的重叠区域,因此采用了第二个NMS(用Io U=0.2 IoU=0.2)来消除作物之间的重复检测. 为了维持分类模型的固定大小输入,被检测到的每个细胞被调整为32×32 32\times 32 px并输入CNN. 之所以选择这个大小,是因为95%的细胞为19×18 19\times 18 px或更小,同时保留了侧相比并最大限度地减少大多数细胞的扭曲. 在重新调整规模时采用了反变相法,以避免对大细胞进行下取样。

blocks.en: 2.4 Cell Classification
blocks.zh: 2.4 细胞分类

blocks.en: We trained a compact CNN classifier (Fig. 2 ) on 137,434 annotated cells (120,983 live and 16,451 dead) from 60 stained images to predict cell viability. The dataset was split into 80% training and 20% validation, preserving the label distribution across both subsets. It was trained using cross-entropy loss and the Adam optimizer [ 20 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} for 50 epochs. The CNN has 651,234 651,234 learnable parameters and requires 14.96 million FLOPs, with an inference time of approximately 0.50 0.50 ms per-sample on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. Once the model is trained, it can be applied to individual cell patches from either stained or unstained images. Since the model outputs a two-element softmax vector (probability of live vs. dead), the final label is assigned with a 0.5 decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们在137 434个注解的细胞(120 983个活体,16 451个死亡)上培训了CNN的紧凑分类器(图2),从60个被污染的图像中预测细胞的可行性。 数据集被分为80%的培训和20%的验证,保留了两个子集的标签分布. 其训练时采用交叉通体损失和亚当优化器[20],50个时代的学习率为10-6 10-Q-6}. CNN有651,234,651,234个可学习参数,需要14,96万个FLOP,一个NVIDIA A100 GPU上的每样样本的推断时间约为0.50 0.50 ms. 一旦该模型经过了训练,就可以被应用到从被污或未被污的图像中取出的个人细胞补丁上. 由于模型输出出一个双元素软max向量(活活活活对死的可能性),最终的标签被指定为0.5决定阈值.

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价计量

blocks.en: We provide separate evaluation metrics for both cell detection and classification stages of the pipeline, along with an end-to-end evaluation metric for viability analysis on unstained samples. For cell detection on stained samples, we report precision, recall, F1-score, and mean Average Precision (mAP) at an IoU threshold of 0.5 using PLX bounding box annotations as the reference (exact definitions in Supplement 1). We also compare methods based on total cell counts. Since reference bounding boxes are not available for unstained images, evaluation on these samples is limited to total cell counts and qualitative visual comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们为输油管的细胞检测和分类阶段分别提供评价衡量标准,以及用于对未覆盖样品进行可行性分析的从端到端评价衡量标准。 关于对被污染样品的细胞检测,我们报告精确度、召回率、F1-分数和平均精度(mAP),IOU阈值为0.5,使用PLX边框说明作为参考(第1号补编中的确切定义)。 我们还根据细胞总数来比较方法。 由于未覆盖的图像不提供参考边框,对这些样本的评价仅限于细胞总数和定性可视性比较。

blocks.en: Classifier performance is evaluated on both the training and validation sets using the confusion matrix, overall accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Due to the class imbalance ( 88 % 88\% live cells), precision, recall, and F1-score are computed with respect to the dead (minority) class. Additionally, we report the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, area under the curve (AUC), and the precision–recall curve.
blocks.zh: 使用混淆矩阵、总体准确度、精确度、回溯率和F1-分数,在培训和验证组上评价分类器的性能。 由于班级不平衡(88%为88+++活细胞),精确度,召回和F1-分数按照已死亡(少数)班级计算. 此外,我们报告接收器的操作特性曲线、曲线下的区域和精确-召回曲线。

blocks.en: Sample-level viability is quantified as the number of live cells divided by the total number of cells. We applied our full pipeline to 15 stained and unstained image pairs. Since PLX provides viability measurements only for stained samples, we treat PLX measured viability of each stained image as the reference for its corresponding unstained pair. Overall performance is summarized by the mean absolute error (MAE) and coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} score).
blocks.zh: 样本级生存能力量化为活细胞数除以细胞总数. 我们用我们的全部管道 15个污秽和不污秽的图像对。 由于PLX只为被污染的样本提供可行性测量,我们把被污染的每个图像的被测量的PLX可行性作为相应的未被污染成对的参考. 总的表现以平均绝对差错(MAE)和确定系数(R 2 R^{2})来总结.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: We first perform a calibration run using stained cells to determine whether live and dead cell populations exhibit distinct signatures under brightfield imaging. We then perform the same analysis to show that stained and unstained cells share sufficiently similar image features to allow a model trained on stained samples to generalize to unstained ones. We then present results for the cell detection, cell viability classifier, and an end-to-end evaluation of our pipeline on unstained samples.
blocks.zh: 我们首先利用被污染的细胞进行校正,以确定活细胞和死细胞群在亮地成像下是否表现出不同的特征。 然后我们进行同样的分析,以显示有污和无污的细胞具有足够相近的图像特征,使受过有污迹样本培训的模型能够被概括到有污迹的细胞中去。 然后我们提出细胞检测结果、细胞生存能力分类器 以及对未覆盖样本的管道进行端到端评价。

blocks.en: 3.1 Live and Dead Cell Discrimination in Brightfield Imaging
blocks.zh: 3.1 Brightfield图像中的活细胞和死细胞歧视

blocks.en: Our hypothesis is that live and dead cell populations exhibit sufficient differences in brightfield images that they can be distinguished by their morphology alone. To test this, we use unsupervised machine learning to compare individual cell images and sort them into representative groups. For simplicity of presentation, we map the original high-dimensional space of the images into a 2D scatter plots. After running the algorithms, interpretation of the resulting clusters is assisted by applying the PLX labels for cell detection and viability labeling.
blocks.zh: 我们的假设是活细胞和活细胞群在亮地图像中表现出足够的差异,它们可以单独通过形态来区分. 为了测试这一点,我们使用无监督的机器学习来比较单个细胞的图像,把它们排序成具有代表性的组. 为了简单展示,我们将图像的原始高维空间映射到一个2D散射地块. 在运行算法后,通过应用PLX标签来进行细胞检测和可行性标签,协助解释由此产生的集群.

blocks.en: We applied three dimensionality reduction algorithms to the cell populations (vectorized and standardized prior to dimensionality reduction): Principal Component Analysis (PCA) [ 33 ] , t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) [ 43 ] , and Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) [ 28 ] . PCA projects data onto directions of maximum variance, providing a linear view of the feature space. t-SNE and UMAP are nonlinear methods that preserve both local and global structure by grouping similar samples and separating dissimilar ones in a low-dimensional embedding [ 17 ] . UMAP has been used for similar tasks, including rare cell population detection [ 49 ] , RNA sequencing visualization [ 1 ] , arrhythmia detection in cardiac waveforms [ 45 ] , and phenotyping microglial cells [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们在细胞群中应用了三种维度还原算法(在维度还原前已实现量化和标准化):主要成分分析[33],t-分布d Stochastic Nebor Embedding (t-SNE) [43],和"统一曼尼佛"的相貌和投影(UMAP) [28]. PCA将数据投射到最大差异的方向上,提供特征空间的线性视图. t-SNE和UMAP是非线性方法,通过将相似的样本分组并用低维嵌入来分离异样来保存局部和全局结构[17]. UMAP被用于类似的任务,包括稀有细胞群检测[49],RNA测序可视化[1],心电波形态中的心律失常检测[45],以及平分微滑细胞[10].

blocks.en: Results of the 2D embeddings are shown in Fig. 3 . To create a 2D plot using PCA, we keep only the first two principal components (a poor cutoff in this case, as they capture only ∼ \sim 30% of the total variance). In the raw output, i.e. without added labels, the points overlap, and there is no way to distinguish live vs. dead cells; adding labels reveals their positions, showing that the cells below the diagonal are mostly live. t-SNE and UMAP, however, produce much more noticeable separation between live and dead cell populations, due to their ability to preserve local nonlinear structure that a linear mapping cannot capture.
blocks.zh: 2D嵌入结果如图3所示. 为了使用 PCPA 创建 2D 的地块, 我们只保留前两个主要组件( 此处的截断率差, 因为它们只捕捉总相差的 \ sim 30%) 。 在生输出中,即没有添加标签,点相重叠,没有方法区分活对死细胞;添加标签会揭示出它们的位置,显示对角膜下方的细胞大多活. 然而,T-SNE和UMAP在活细胞群和死细胞群之间产生了更显著的分离,因为它们能够保持线性映射无法捕捉的局部非线性结构.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Comparison of live and dead cells under brightfield imaging. Top row: Two-dimensional embeddings obtained via PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP, computed from 137,434 137{,}434 stained cells captured from 60 60 samples. Live cells are shown in green and dead cells in red. A k-NN classifier is applied to the 2D embeddings and original cells for live vs. dead classification, as shown in the rightmost panel. Bottom row: Average Fourier spectra of live and dead cell patches (left two panels) and their horizontal and vertical cross-sections through the frequency origin (right two panels).
blocks.zh: 图3:亮地成像下活细胞和死细胞的比较. 上行:通过五氯苯甲醚、T-SNE和UMAP从从60个样本中捕获的137 434 137{,}434个有污点的细胞中得到的二维嵌入物。 活细胞以绿色和死细胞以红色显示. k-NN分类器被应用于活对死分类的2D嵌入和原始单元格上,如最右面板所显示. 下行:活细胞和死细胞补丁的平均傅里叶光谱(左两面板)及其通过频率源的横向和纵向截面(右两面板).

blocks.en: To further characterize the image features of live and dead populations, we computed the average Fourier spectrum across all live and dead cells [ 31 ] . As shown in Fig. 3 , live cells exhibit markedly higher frequency content than dead cells, particularly along the principal frequency axes. This is consistent with the biological expectation that live cells possess sharper, more well-defined membrane boundaries and denser intracellular structure, both of which contribute to stronger high-frequency components in the Fourier domain. Dead cells exhibit smoother and more diffuse intensity profiles, esp. in the tails of the distribution, reflecting membrane degradation and loss of structural integrity.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步说明活人和死人的形象特征,我们计算了所有活人和活人细胞的平均Fourier谱 [31]。 如图3所示,活细胞的频率含量明显高于死细胞,特别是在主要频率轴上。 这符合生物预期,活细胞具有更尖锐,更清晰的膜分界和更密集的细胞内结构,两者都促进了傅里叶域中更强高频的成分. 死细胞呈现出更平滑更分散的强度剖面,在分布的尾部为esp.,反映了膜退化和结构完整性的丧失.

blocks.en: A common way to quantitatively assess the separation is to train a k k -nearest-neighbors (KNN) classifier directly on the 2D embeddings, which assigns each point the majority label among its k k nearest neighbors in the embedding space [ 28 ] . This measures how well live and dead cells are grouped within their own population and separated from the other in the 2D space. t-SNE and UMAP achieve an accuracy of up to ∼ \sim 95% and an F1-score of ∼ \sim 0.80 across a range of k k values. We also applied the same KNN classification to the original high-dimensional cell representations, which yielded comparable performance to t-SNE and UMAP, indicating nonlinear embeddings largely preserve the local structure relevant to distinguishing live and dead cells. Together, these results indicate that live and dead cells occupy distinct regions of the image-feature space, and and this low-dimensional separation reflects the structure of the original high-dimensional cell.
blocks.zh: 定量评估分离的一个常见方法是在2D嵌入物上直接训练出克-近邻(KNN)分级器,在嵌入物空间中,将每个分点分配给其克最近的相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相相相相邻相邻相邻相邻相 这种方法衡量了生活和死亡的细胞在自己的人群中如何组合,在二维空间中与另一细胞分离。 t- SNE 和 UMAP 的精度达到 \\ sim 95% , 在 k k 值范围内达到 F1 分 \ sim 0.80 。 我们还将相同的KNN分类应用于原始高维细胞表达法,它产生了与t-SNE和UMAP相似的性能,表明非线性嵌入物在很大程度上保留了与区分活细胞和死细胞相关的局部结构. 这些结果共同表明活细胞和死细胞占据了图像-地貌空间的不同区域,而这种低维分化反映了原始高维细胞的结构.

blocks.en: Closer inspection of the UMAP embedding in Fig. 4 reveals that the dead-cell population decomposes into two morphologically distinct sub-clusters. The first (red cluster) consists of cells that appear predominantly white and featureless, with the membrane outline still visible but a marked loss or degradation of intracellular content. The second (blue cluster) comprises cells with a heterogeneous appearance, with a visible but less distinct membrane outline. We speculate that the red cluster may reflect a later stage of cell death in which membrane permeabilization has led to substantial loss or degradation of intracellular content, producing a homogeneous appearance. The blue cluster, retaining a faint but discernible membrane outline is broadly consistent with reports that membrane-compromised cells appear as a blurred halo in brightfield imagery [ 32 ] , and may represent an earlier or otherwise distinct stage of membrane degradation.
blocks.zh: 更仔细地检查图4所嵌入的UMAP显示,死细胞群会分解成两个形态上独立的分群. 第一种(红色集群)由以白色为主而无特征的细胞所组成,细胞膜轮廓仍然可见,但细胞内含量明显减少或退化. 第二(蓝色集群)由外观各异的细胞所组成,具有可见但不太明显的膜外观轮廓. 我们推测,红团可能反映细胞死亡后期,细胞膜渗透导致细胞内含量大量丢失或退化,产生同质外观. 蓝色集群,保留了微弱但可分辨出膜的外观轮廓,与关于膜折合细胞在亮地图像中作为模糊光环而出现的报告大体一致[32],并可能代表了膜退化的更早阶段或其他独特的阶段.

blocks.en: The ability to distinguish morphologically distinct dead-cell subpopulations highlights a key advantage of unsupervised representation learning: unlike supervised classifiers that collapse all dead cells into a single label, unsupervised embeddings preserve morphological diversity, enabling cell phenotyping without any label. Live cells (green cluster), by contrast, have sharp membrane boundaries and moderate intracellular texture. The UMAP embedding also exposes a cluster of irregular crops (cyan cluster). These may be attributable to overlapping cells, where the bounding box inevitably includes a small portion of an adjacent cell. They may also result from PLX detection errors where the cell body extends beyond the patch boundary. The separation of these malformed samples from the main clusters demonstrates that UMAP can effectively identify outlier samples in the dataset [ 16 , 45 ] . Removing these samples improves dataset quality and leads to more consistent training.
blocks.zh: 辨别形态上截然不同的死细胞亚群的能力凸显出无监督的表达学习的关键优势: 不同于被监督的分类器将所有死细胞分解为单一的标签,无监督的嵌入物保持了形态多样性,使得细胞无任何标签地进行异构. 活细胞(Green cluster),相形之下,具有尖锐的膜分界和中性细胞内质地. UMAP嵌入还暴露出一组不规则的作物(氰集群). 这些原因可能是由于单元格相重叠,其中相接的方框不可避免地包括了相邻单元格的一小部分。 它们也可能产生于细胞体延伸出补丁边界的PLX检测出错. 从主要集群中分离出这些畸形样本,表明UMAP能够有效地在数据集中识别出值样本[16,45]. 取出这些样本可以提高数据集的质量并导致更加一致的培训。

Right: representative brightfield cell patches from each cluster. Green and yellow frames around each cell represent live and dead, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图4:无监督地通过UMAP对活细胞和死细胞进行分泌. 左:由集群嵌入了UMAP,由集群在视觉分离的基础上手动确定. 对:每个星团都有代表性的亮地单元格补丁. 每个细胞周围的绿色和黄色相框分别代表活体和死亡.

blocks.en: 3.2 Similarity of Stained and Unstained Cells in Brightfield Imaging
blocks.zh: 3.2 Brightfield成像中的有污和有污的单元格的相似性

blocks.en: Our unsupervised methods allow us to prove a key assumption underlying all previous imaging in cell classification: that unstained brightfield cell images sufficiently resemble their stained counterparts, such that a model trained on stained images can generalize to unstained ones. (Proving this also motivated our use of fluorescent staining to generate cell viability ground truth, rather than visible exclusion stains such as trypan blue or erythrosin B, which would dramatically alter the brightfield appearance of the cells.) For confirmation, we collected populations of unpaired stained and unstained individual cells, where cell extraction in both conditions was performed using our trained model to ensure consistency. Although the stained and unstained images come from the same bioreactor sample, no one-to-one correspondence between individual cells across the two conditions can be established. This is because adding the stain and mixing disturbs the cells’ positions within the well, making it impossible to track and image the same individual cells before and after staining.
blocks.zh: 我们未经监督的方法使我们能够证明一个关键假设,这是细胞分类中所有先前成像的基础:未染色的亮地细胞图像与被染色的对等图像足够相像,这样,一个受过被染色图像培训的模型就可以被概括为被染色的. (证明这一点也促使我们使用荧光污渍来生成细胞生存能力地面的真伪,而不是可见的排斥污迹,如特潘蓝或红霉素B等,这些会大大地改变细胞的亮地外观. ) 为了证实这一点,我们收集了未沾染和未沾染的单个细胞群,在这些细胞群中,使用我们训练有素的模式进行两地的取出,以确保一致性。 虽然被污和未被污的图像出自同一种生物反应物样本,但是无法在两种条件的单个细胞之间建立一对一的对应关系. 这是因为增加污迹和混合会扰动油井内的细胞位置,使得在污迹发生前后无法跟踪和映像同一个细胞.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , applying PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP to the cell populations produces intermixing of stained and unstained cells in the projected 2D space. This indicates that the two populations occupy overlapping regions of the feature space. To quantify this, we trained the same KNN classifier used in our live/dead analysis to distinguish stained from unstained cells. Across all four representations, including the original high-dimensional cells, classification accuracy remains low ( ∼ \sim 56–68%) and close to chance level, well below the ∼ \sim 95% accuracy achieved on the live/dead task. Likewise, the Fourier profiles of stained vs. unstained cells are nearly identical. Taken together, the results show that AO and PI staining does not substantially alter cell appearance under brightfield imaging.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,将五氯苯甲醚、t-SNE和UMAP应用于细胞群,会产生预测的2D空间中被污染和未被污染的细胞的混合。 这表明这两个群体占据着重叠的地物空间。 为了量化这一点,我们训练了同样的KNN分类器,用于活性/死性分析,以区分有污和无污的细胞. 在包括原始高维格在内的所有四个表述中,分类精度仍然很低(\sim 56-68%),接近机会水平,远远低于活/死任务所达到的\sim 95%的精度。 同样地,Fourier的污损与未被污损的细胞的剖面几乎完全相同。 综合起来,结果显示AO和PI的污迹在亮地成像下不会实质性地改变细胞外观.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cell Detection Performance
blocks.zh: 3.3 细胞检测 业绩

blocks.en: We compared the trained model against three baselines: (1) the Cellaca™ PLX image cytometer, (2) a classical image-processing pipeline (details in Supplement 1), and (3) the pre-trained Cellpose [ 42 ] . Fig. 6 shows qualitative detection results on stained and unstained images (more examples in Supplement 1). PLX provides bounding-box annotations only for stained samples - and thus is not applicable in label-free settings - and its system misses a noticeable number of cells. However, these cells still exhibit fluorescence signals, suggesting that the omissions are likely due to limitations of the detection algorithm rather than any biological difference. The image-processing pipeline performs well on isolated cells but struggles to accurately resolve overlapping or aggregated cells (known as cell clumping). On the other hand, localizing and studying cell clumps may itself be of interest, and image processing can provide bounding boxes for these scenarios. Despite its limitations at the instance level, it can also provide a lower bound on the total number of cells in the sample (as all cells within a clump are counted as a single detection). Cellpose struggles with cells exhibiting a white appearance, which are primarily dead cells, and often produces inaccurate segmentation, including overly large merged regions or excessively small spurious detections. In contrast, our approach can detect cells even within tightly clustered regions. Further, it provides a confidence score for each prediction, which can be used to filter out low-confidence detections and improve robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们把训练有素的模型与三个基线进行比较:(1) CellacaTM PLX 图像细胞仪,(2) 一个古典图像处理管道(详见第1号补编)和(3) 预先训练的Cellpose [42]。 图6显示有污和无污图像的质量检测结果(更多实例见补编1)。 PLX 仅为被污染的样本提供绑定框说明,因此不适用于无标签的设置,其系统缺失了明显数量的单元格。 然而,这些细胞仍然表现出荧光信号,这表明这些遗漏很可能是由于检测算法的限制,而不是任何生物差异. 图像处理管道在被隔离的细胞上表现良好,但难以准确解决相重叠或聚合的细胞(被称作细胞发光). 另一方面,本地化和研究细胞团本身可能值得关注,图像处理可以为这些情景提供边框. 尽管在实例层面存在局限性,它也可以对样本中的细胞总数提供更低的约束(因为一个突起中的所有细胞都算作单一检测). 细胞与显示白色外观的细胞发生斗争,这些细胞主要是死细胞,并且往往产生不准确的分化,包括过于大的合并区域或过小的假检测. 相比之下,我们的方法可以探测到即使在紧密集群区域内的细胞。 此外,它还为每个预测提供了信心分数,可用于过滤出低信心检测并增强稳健性.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports detection performance for all four methods on stained and unstained images. For stained samples, we report cell counts, precision, recall, F1-score, and mAP; for unstained samples we report only cell counts due to the absence of reference annotations. For cell counts, our method detects approximately 17% more cells compared to the PLX measurement (on the training set). Visual inspection across different samples suggests that our method is able to recover missed or inaccurate bounding boxes. This also suggests that training on a large set of imperfect annotations may allow a deep learning model to generalize beyond individual annotation errors and recover missed cells. Cellpose detects slightly more cells than our method, but visual inspection indicates that some of these detections correspond to very small false-positive cells or large bounding boxes that do not correspond to individual cells. Overall, our method achieves the best performance across most evaluation metrics, with m ​ A ​ P ≥ 0.9 mAP\geq 0.9 on both the training and test sets.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了对有污和无污图像的所有四种方法的探测性能。 对于被污染的样本,我们报告细胞计数,精度,回想,F1-分数,和mAP;对于未被污染的样本,我们只报告细胞计数,因为没有参考说明. 对于细胞计数,我们的方法比PLX的测量(在训练集上)多检测出大约17%的细胞. 对不同样本的目视检查表明,我们的方法能够恢复缺失或不准确的边框. 这还表明,关于一大批不完善说明的培训可能允许一种深入的学习模式,在单个注释错误之外加以概括并取回缺失的细胞. 细胞质检测比我们的方法略多一些细胞,但视觉检查显示,其中一些检测与非常小的假阳性细胞或与单个细胞不相匹配的大边框对应. 总体而言,我们的方法在大多数评价指标中都取得了最佳业绩,在培训和测试组合中,M A P 0.9 mAP\geq 0.9。

blocks.en: Cell appearance can vary across focal planes, and the detection model should remain robust to such focus-dependent changes. To verify this, we evaluated the pipeline on a focal stack acquired at a fixed field of view, with ten different focal planes (Fig. 7 ; additional example in Supplement 1). Due to slight sample movement during acquisition, cells are not perfectly registered across planes, with some entering or leaving the field of view. Despite this, the model consistently detected 50 ± 2 50\pm 2 cells across all of the focal range and correctly identify all of the cells within each focal plane.
blocks.zh: 细胞外观会因焦平面而异,而检测模型应保持坚固,以适应这种依赖焦的变化. 为了核实这一点,我们评估了在固定视场获得的焦堆上输油管,有10个不同的焦平面(图7;补编1中的其他例子)。 由于在获取过程中样本略有移动,细胞在飞机之间没有完全注册,有些进入或离开视野. 尽管如此,该模型始终检测出所有焦距的50±2 50\pm 2细胞,并正确识别出每个焦平面内的所有细胞.

blocks.en: 3.4 Cell Classification Performance
blocks.zh: 3.4 细胞分类 业绩

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 8 , the CNN model achieves 98.64% accuracy (F1-score = 0.94) on the training set and 98.10% accuracy (F1-score = 0.92) on the validation set, with AUC values of 0.9978 and 0.9958, respectively. The precision-recall curves further support strong classification performance, with average precision of 0.9858 on training and 0.9749 on validation. The loss and accuracy curves in Fig. 8 show close agreement between training and validation across epochs, confirming that the model generalizes well without overfitting.

blocks.en: 3.5 End-to-End Viability Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.5 终到终有效预测

blocks.en: We applied our pipeline to 15 samples with paired stained and unstained images, with PLX viability measurements on stained samples serving as reference. Sample-level viability is predicted with our pipeline, and performance is evaluated using both MAE and the R 2 R^{2} score, with 90% confidence intervals (CI) obtained via bootstrap resampling. Results are summarized in Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh: 我们把管道用在15个样本上,上面有成对的有污和无污的图像,对有污的样本进行PLX可行性测量作为参考。 利用我们的管道来预测样本水平的可行性,并使用MAE和R 2 R^{2}的分数来评价性能,90%的置信间隔(CI)通过靴子重新取样获得。 图9概述了结果。

blocks.en: For stained samples, we achieved an MAE of 3.57% (90% CI: [2.75, 4.47]) and R 2 R^{2} of 0.82 (90% CI: [0.60, 0.92]). The scatter plot shows our predictions falling slightly below PLX measurements across most samples; a potential reason is that our detection model identifies more cells than PLX, and these additional cells tend to have lower viability, which pulls down the overall sample-level estimate. A population-level analysis using the unsupervised algorithm UMAP. For stained samples, where ground-truth labels are available, UMAP is applied to cells extracted and labeled by PLX, revealing visually separable live and dead clusters. By visualizing representative examples from each cluster in the UMAP plot (Fig. 9 ), we observe distinct morphological patterns: Cluster 1 consists of sharp, well-defined cells that are predominantly live; Cluster 2 contains featureless, translucent cells lacking internal structure; Cluster 3 comprises fuzzy, blurred cells that frequently contain a small dark internal punctum, which may correspond to a condensed nucleus or debris material; and Cluster 4 captures image patches containing multiple adjoining cells, likely corresponding to cells undergoing division.
blocks.zh: 对于有污渍的样品,我们达到的MAE为3.57%(90%的CI:[2.75,4.47])和R2R^{2}0.82 (90%的CI:[0.60,0.92])。 散射地图显示了我们在整个大多数样本中略低于PLX测量的预测;一个潜在的原因是,我们的检测模型识别出比PLX更多的细胞,这些额外的细胞往往具有更低的可行性,这拉低了总体样本水平的估计. 使用无监督算法UMAP进行人口级分析. 对于有地面真实标签的有污迹样本,UMAP被应用到由PLX取出并贴有标签的细胞上,揭示出可视分离活体和死体集群. 通过可视化UMAP地块(图9)中每个集群的代表性例子,我们观测到不同的形态模式: 第1组由以活性为主的尖锐而清晰的细胞组成; 第2组包含无地貌,半透明细胞缺乏内部结构; 第3组由模糊,模糊的细胞组成,经常包含一个小的深色内凹口,可能与被凝固的核或碎片材料相对应; 第4组包含多个相接细胞的图像补丁,可能与正在分裂的细胞相对应.

blocks.en: For unstained samples, we achieved an MAE of 2.68% (90% CI: [1.72, 3.89]) and R 2 R^{2} of 0.85 (90% CI: [0.73, 0.93]). We conducted an analogous UMAP analysis, where cells are extracted using the trained model and labeled with the CNN classifier. Predicted dead cells are grouped closely together in the embedding, and again we observe four main clusters,suggesting that the CNN has learned discriminative features that generalize beyond stained samples. Examining representative unstained cells from the UMAP embedding reveals morphological patterns that closely mirror those observed in the stained samples: Cluster 1 again consists of sharp cells that are predominantly predicted live; Cluster 2 contains cells with a white appearance resembling those in stained Cluster 2 and is mostly predicted as dead; Cluster 3 comprises the majority of predicted-dead cells, which appear fuzzy and blurred; and Cluster 4 similarly captures image patches with multiple adjoining cells, likely corresponding to cells undergoing division. This correspondence suggests that the visual features distinguishing live and dead cells are largely preserved between stained and unstained imaging, supporting the CNN’s ability to generalize across modalities.
blocks.zh: 对于未覆盖的样本,我们实现了2.68%(90%的CI:[1.72,3.89])和0.85(90%的CI:[0.73,0.93])的R 2 R^{2}。 我们进行了类似的UMAP分析,利用训练有素的模型取出细胞,并贴有CNN分类器的标签. 预想的死细胞被紧密地组合在嵌入体中,我们再次观察到了四个主要集群,暗示CNN已经学到了超越污点样本的歧视性特征。 检查来自UMAP嵌入物的具有代表性的未染色细胞,揭示出与所染色样品中观测到的形态模式相近: 第1组再次由以预测活性为主的尖锐细胞组成; 第2组包含白色外观与被污染的第2组类似并大多被预测为已死亡的细胞; 第3组包含大多数被预测死亡的细胞,这些细胞看起来模糊而模糊; 第4组类似地捕捉有多个相邻细胞的图像补丁,可能与正在分裂的细胞对应. 这些信件表明,区分活细胞和死细胞的视觉特征在很大程度上被保存在有污和无污的成像之间,支持了CNN将各种模式概括起来的能力。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results demonstrate that deep-learning-based cell detection and classification can predict sample-level viability directly from unstained brightfield images, closely matching the reference measurements obtained from stained samples. Compared to virtual staining approaches, which predict fluorescence images from brightfield inputs and require cell counting and viability analysis as a subsequent post-processing step, our method produces per-cell viability predictions directly. Virtual staining also inherits an ambiguity present in physical staining: some cells appear in both fluorescent channels simultaneously, and a virtual staining model can replicate this effect, making viability classification more ill-defined. The detection-and-classification paradigm avoids these issues entirely. Furthermore, the output of the classifier provides a continuous probability of being live or dead rather than a hard binary label, offering a more quantitative and nuanced characterization of cell viability. The temperature parameter of the softmax can also be adjusted before training to control the sharpness of these probabilities, allowing more or less deterministic predictions. A similar score is available from the detection stage, where the objectness confidence can be used to filter out low-quality bounding box proposals. A natural future direction is to train on paired brightfield and fluorescence crops of single cells (e.g., virtual staining at the single-cell level) to provide richer information about cell health while remaining compatible with the detection-then-classification paradigm introduced here.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,以深入学习为基础的细胞检测和分类可以直接从未覆盖的亮地图像中预测样本水平的可行性,与从有污迹的样本中获得的参考测量数据密切相匹配。 相较于虚拟出污方法,即从亮地输入中预测出荧光图像并需要细胞计数和可行性分析作为随后的后处理步骤,我们的方法直接产生每个细胞的可行性预测. 虚拟地污也继承了物理地污中存在的模糊:一些细胞同时出现在两个荧光道上,而虚拟地污迹模型可以复制这种效果,使得可行性分类更不明确. 检测和分类模式完全避免了这些问题。 此外,分类器的输出提供了活或死的持续概率,而不是硬二进制标签,为细胞生存能力提供了更量化和细微的特征描述. 软马克斯的温度参数也可以在训练前被调整来控制这些概率的锐度,从而可以或多或少地进行决定性的预测. 检测阶段也有类似的分数,可以使用对象自信来过滤出低质量的边框建议. 一个自然的未来方向是训练单细胞的对接亮场和荧光收成(例如,在单细胞层面的虚拟污迹),以提供更丰富的细胞健康信息,同时保持与这里引入的检测-当时的分类范式相兼容.

blocks.en: Several factors can influence pipeline performance. Focal plane is one such factor: as shown in Fig. 7 , predictions on the same cell captured at different depths can vary, particularly for the viability classifier, which may not have been exposed to all focal planes during training. Nevertheless, a focal stack of individual cells opens the opportunity for three-dimensional reconstruction of cell structure [ 34 ] , which could potentially improve viability classification. Bounding box accuracy is another source of variability: the same cell classified under slightly shifted bounding boxes can receive different viability labels, as the crop content changes. One way to address this is to jointly train the detector and classifier by optimizing the detector for live, dead, and background classes rather than cell versus background alone. However, since object detectors return multiple overlapping proposals per cell and each potentially receiving a different live/dead prediction, this formulation complicates downstream NMS and requires careful design, unless using architectures that avoid NMS altogether, such as DETR [ 3 ] . In addition, because individual cells are small relative to the original image, the trained model must be applied to smaller regions. Rather than manually cropping these regions, the bounding boxes generated by image processing can provide candidate cell regions with fewer overlapping cells, which can then be processed by the trained model.
blocks.zh: 若干因素可能影响管道的性能。 焦平面是其中的一个因素:如图7所示,在不同深度捕获的同个细胞的预测可能会有差异,特别是对可行性分级器而言,在训练期间可能没有接触过所有焦平面. 尽管如此,单个细胞的焦点堆放为细胞结构的三维重建提供了机会[34],这有可能改善可行性分类. 相接箱精度是可变性的另一个来源:同一组被划入略移相接箱的相接箱中,随着作物含量的变化,可以得到不同的生存性标签. 解决这个问题的一个方法是通过优化活的、死的和背景的检测器,而不是单靠细胞和背景来联合培训检测器和分类器。 然而,由于物体探测器返回每个细胞的多个相重叠的建议,并且每个可能得到不同的活/死预测,这种配体使下游NMS复杂化并需要仔细设计,除非使用完全避免NMS的架构,如DETR [3]. 此外,由于单个细胞相对于原始图像来说是很小的,所以训练有素的模型必须被应用到较小的区域. 由图像处理所生成的边框,与其人工裁剪这些区域,不如为候选细胞区域提供较少的相重叠的细胞,然后可以被训练有素的模型处理.

blocks.en: In Supplement 1, we repeat all experiments using a higher-resolution microscope across different imaging modalities and focal planes, and results remain consistent, supporting the generalizability of our claims. When multiple modalities or focal planes are available at training time, multi-modal learning can further improve performance over any single modality. Finally, we have shown that nonlinear dimensionality reduction via UMAP enables unsupervised phenotyping of live and dead cell populations. In the multi-modal setting, manifold alignment offers a complementary tool: by mapping cell representations from different imaging conditions onto a shared low-dimensional space, it can enhance the discriminability of live and dead populations across modalities and facilitate knowledge transfer between imaging conditions [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 在补编1中,我们重复使用不同成像方式和焦平面的更高分辨率显微镜进行的所有实验,结果仍然一致,支持我们主张的普遍性。 如果在培训时有多种模式或联络飞机,多式联运可以比任何单一模式进一步提高绩效。 最后,我们已经表明,通过UMAP减少非线性维度,可以使活细胞和死细胞群无所监督地进行分泌。 在多模式环境中,多重对接提供了一种补充工具:通过将不同成像条件的细胞表达图映射到一个共享的低维空间,它可以加强不同模式活人口和死亡人口的区别性,并便利成像条件之间的知识转让[44].

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented an deep-learning-based pipeline for cell viability assessment directly from unstained brightfield images. We first established that live and dead cells exhibit distinct morphological signatures under stained brightfield imaging, and that stained and unstained cells share closely matched image features. These two findings jointly justify training on stained samples and deploying on unstained ones. Our pipeline combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a compact CNN classifier for live/dead prediction, achieving a mean absolute error of 2.68% on unstained CHO cells across a wide range of viability conditions. These results open new possibilities for continuous, non-invasive monitoring of cell health.
blocks.zh: 我们直接从未覆盖的亮地图像中为细胞生存能力评估提供了一个深入学习的管道。 我们首先确定,活细胞和死细胞在有污点的亮地成像下表现出明显的形态特征,而有污点和无污点的细胞有着紧密相匹配的图像特征。 这两项调查结果共同证明对有污物样本进行培训和对未有污物样本进行部署是合理的。 我们的管道结合了一个细胞检测模型,将单个细胞定位与一个紧凑的CNN分级器用于活/死预测,在一系列广泛的生存条件下,在未覆盖的CHO细胞上实现2.68%的平均绝对误差. 这些结果为持续、非侵入性地监测细胞健康提供了新的可能性。
